title: Toward a rational design of the assembly structure of polymetallic asymmetric catalysts: design, synthesis, and evaluation of new chiral ligands for catalytic asymmetric cyanation reactions

synthesis.procedure: Ligand 4 (89.0 mg, 0.20 mmol) was dissolved in THF (3.0 mL) and Gd(OiPr)3 (0.2 M in THF, 500 μL, 0.10 mmol) was added at room temperature. The mixture was stirred at 54 °C for 1 h, then the solvent was evaporated at 0 °C. The residue was dried under reduced pressure (<5 mmHg) for 2 h and dissolved in propionitrile (350 μL). After 1 day, colorless prisms of the 3:4+2OH complex formed. The solvent was removed with a syringe, the crystals were washed twice with propionitrile, and dried under vacuum (68 mg, 77%).
synthesis.temperature: room temperature addition; stirred at 54 °C; evaporated at 0 °C; crystallization at ambient temperature
synthesis.time: stirred 1 h; dried 2 h; crystallization after 1 day
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing then crystallization from propionitrile
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent evaporated at 0 °C; residue dried under vacuum (<5 mmHg) for 2 h; dissolved in propionitrile; colorless prisms washed twice with propionitrile and dried under vacuum
